title: Beckmann rearrangement of ketoximes for accessing amides and lactams promoted by a perimidine-2-thione supported Hg(II) complex: a mechanistic perception
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24317-24330
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02843D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Priyanka Velmurugan, Poovarasan Kanniyappan, Tapas Ghatak
A newly synthesized Hg(II)–perimidine-2-thione complex catalyzes the Beckmann rearrangement across a broad range of oximes, enabling high-yield access to amides and lactams.
